notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for receive-order object-removal delivery after subscription withdrawal. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies ordinary publication, registration, discovery, deletion, a queued terminal removal, withdrawal of one active subscription before callback servicing, callback-model boundaries, and standard federation cleanup. The terminal removal remains deliverable for an object already discovered, while the owner receives no loopback, without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary object publication, registration, deletion, and subscription withdrawal with FederateAmbassador discovery and receive-order removal callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-deletion and FederateAmbassador removal declarations
